data.cultural_impact: The name Beller may not have common usage in the English-speaking world, but it has a significant cultural impact in Greek mythology and history. Aside from being the name of the legendary hero Bellerophon, the name also symbolizes fairness, handsomeness, or even beauty in Greek culture. Moreover, the name carries a vivid image of having inherent worth, strength, and courage as portrayed in Greek hero myths.
